method.feature_builder: reuse monthly_features; remove only not_green and green_unknown eligibility reasons; retain every other failure and the full clean 12-month price-history requirement
method.portfolio_selection: pre-outcome features only; Shanghai and Shenzhen separately; require 30 eligible names; k=ceil(n/10); stable code tie-break; equal-weight all, loser, winner, lowvol
method.future_outcomes: generated only after all selections are frozen; lag0 and lag1 use the frozen first-session endpoints and identical selected names
method.unknowns: weighted_month keeps selected unknown weight and never renormalizes known returns; paired comparisons require both complete portfolio returns
method.association: average-rank Spearman and residual association on intercept, momentum rank, and vol60 rank; no group dummies
method.inference: HAC lag 6 over the complete 131-slot monthly axis, retaining missing values; report both planned periods and calendar years
method.fees: 0.25 percent per side on gross drift-adjusted L1 turnover plus final liquidation; first qualified month buys 100 percent; unknown later prior turnover stays unknown
method.comparisons: primary gross uses every paired month with both complete portfolio returns; gross_on_net_sample and after_cost_25bps share the narrower month set where both costs are known
method.memory: two source passes: build all feature rows and freeze all selections, release each stock adapter, then reread one stock at a time to calculate outcomes and release it
method.source_root: derive main repository root from design.source_code[0].path and verify each imported helper file is under that root/src
method.execution_gate: --run requires execution-review.json with accepted=true plus exact run.py and design SHA-256; verifies source/helper and strategy-document hashes; rechecks saved output plan before creating the unique output directory

covers: selection API has no future-outcome input

weighted and paired return arithmetic against hand values
